capabilities: Generate a 9x9 Harada chart from vault folders and notes
Create goal folders, plan folders, and action notes from the chart
Track task completion with checklists and visual progress per cell
Reorder plans and actions by drag-and-drop, including moving notes between plans
Configure master note filename, parent folder, and cell colors
extras: The plugin listing carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; installation is manual only (no community plugin store install described).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view a folder-and-note goal hierarchy as an interactive 9x9 matrix with progress tracking.
summary: Goal-visualization plugin that renders a Harada Method 9x9 chart (1 goal, 8 plans, 64 actions) generated from vault folders and notes.
